definitionZh: 中风 CSS 属性定义了用于绘制元素中风的颜色或 SVG 涂料服务器. 因此,中风只对可以给予中风的元素产生影响(例如,或.);完整列表参见SVG属性上的页面. 声明时,CSS值将超过元素SVG属性的任何值.
sourceDefinition: The stroke CSS property defines the color or SVG paint server used to draw an element's stroke. As such, stroke only has an effect on elements that can be given a stroke (for example, or ); see the page on the SVG attribute for a complete list. When declared, the CSS value overrides any value of the element's SVG attribute.
